summary: A suspension point on the F-22A for one store or launcher: missiles, bombs, tanks, pods

stations.name: left outboard
stations.note: its place derived from hangar's design of the aircraft by the platform's one rule (wing pylons evenly from 25 % to 80 % of the semi-span, 40 % of the local chord aft of the leading edge, 0.6 m below the wing; wingtip rails 0.15 m beyond the tip; fuselage and bay stations at offsets from the CG), its limit by its kind: engineering assumptions, no source giving either; its limit FAS's 5,000 lb per underwing hardpoint (a 600 US gal tank full, ~2044 kg, is carried there)
